verses.en: And there was a man of mount Ephraim, whose name was Micah.
verses.pt: Havia um homem da região montanhosa de Efraim, cujo nome era Mica.
verses.en_web: There was a man of the hill country of Ephraim, whose name was Micah.
verses.en_bbe: Now there was a man of the hill-country of Ephraim named Micah.

verses.en: And he said unto his mother, The eleven hundred shekels of silver that were taken from thee, about which thou cursedst, and spakest of also in mine ears, behold, the silver is with me; I took it. And his mother said, Blessed be thou of the LORD, my son.
verses.pt: Disse este a sua mãe: As mil e cem moedas de prata que te foram tiradas, por cuja causa lançaste maldições, e acerca das quais também me falaste, eis que esse dinheiro está comigo, eu o tomei. Então disse sua mãe: Bendito do Senhor seja meu filho!
verses.en_web: He said to his mother, “The eleven hundred pieces of silver that were taken from you, about which you uttered a curse, and also spoke it in my ears, behold, the silver is with me. I took it.” His mother said, “May Yahweh bless my son!”
verses.en_bbe: And he said to his mother, The eleven hundred shekels of silver which were taken from you, about which you took an oath and said in my hearing, I have given this silver to the Lord from my hand for myself, to make a pictured image and a metal image: see, I have the silver, for I took it: so now I will give it back to you. And his mother said, May the blessing of the Lord be on my son.

verses.en: And when he had restored the eleven hundred shekels of silver to his mother, his mother said, I had wholly dedicated the silver unto the LORD from my hand for my son, to make a graven image and a molten image: now therefore I will restore it unto thee.
verses.pt: E ele restituiu as mil e cem moedas de prata a sua mãe; porém ela disse: Da minha mão dedico solenemente este dinheiro ao Senhor a favor de meu filho, para fazer uma imagem esculpida e uma de fundição; de sorte que agora to tornarei a dar.
verses.en_web: He restored the eleven hundred pieces of silver to his mother, then his mother said, “I most certainly dedicate the silver to Yahweh from my hand for my son, to make a carved image and a molten image. Now therefore I will restore it to you.”
verses.en_bbe: And he gave back the eleven hundred shekels of silver to his mother, and his mother said, I have made the silver holy to the Lord from me for my son, to make a pictured image and a metal image.

verses.en: Yet he restored the money unto his mother; and his mother took two hundred shekels of silver, and gave them to the founder, who made thereof a graven image and a molten image: and they were in the house of Micah.
verses.pt: Quando ele restituiu o dinheiro a sua mãe, ela tomou duzentas moedas de prata, e as deu ao ourives, o qual fez delas uma imagem esculpida e uma de fundição, as quais ficaram em casa de Mica.
verses.en_web: When he restored the money to his mother, his mother took two hundred pieces of silver, and gave them to a silversmith, who made a carved image and a molten image out of it. It was in the house of Micah.
verses.en_bbe: So he gave the silver back to his mother. Then his mother took two hundred shekels of silver and gave them to a metal-worker who made a pictured image and a metal image from them: and it was in the house of Micah.

verses.en: And the man Micah had an house of gods, and made an ephod, and teraphim, and consecrated one of his sons, who became his priest.
verses.pt: Ora, tinha este homem, Mica, uma casa de deuses; e fez um éfode e terafins, e consagrou um de seus filhos, que lhe serviu de sacerdote.
verses.en_web: The man Micah had a house of gods, and he made an ephod, and teraphim, and consecrated one of his sons, who became his priest.
verses.en_bbe: And the man Micah had a house of gods; and he made an ephod and family gods and put one of his sons in the position of priest.

verses.en: In those days there was no king in Israel, but every man did that which was right in his own eyes.
verses.pt: Naquelas dias não havia rei em Israel; cada qual fazia o que parecia bem aos seus olhos.
verses.en_web: In those days there was no king in Israel. Everyone did that which was right in his own eyes.
verses.en_bbe: In those days there was no king in Israel: every man did as seemed right to him.

verses.en: And there was a young man out of Bethlehemjudah of the family of Judah, who was a Levite, and he sojourned there.
verses.pt: E havia um mancebo de Belém de Judá, da família de Judá, que era levita, e peregrinava ali.
verses.en_web: There was a young man out of Bethlehem Judah, of the family of Judah, who was a Levite; and he lived there.
verses.en_bbe: Now there was a young man living in Beth-lehem-judah, of the family of Judah and a Levite, who was not a townsman of the place.

verses.en: And the man departed out of the city from Bethlehemjudah to sojourn where he could find a place: and he came to mount Ephraim to the house of Micah, as he journeyed.
verses.pt: Este homem partiu da cidade de Belém de Judá para peregrinar onde quer que achasse conveniente. Seguindo ele o seu caminho, chegou à região montanhosa de Efraim, à casa de Mica,
verses.en_web: The man departed out of the city, out of Bethlehem Judah, to live where he could find a place, and he came to the hill country of Ephraim, to the house of Micah, as he traveled.
verses.en_bbe: And he went away from the town of Beth-lehem-judah, looking for somewhere to make his living-place; and on his journey he came to the hill-country of Ephraim, to the house of Micah.

verses.en: And Micah said unto him, Whence comest thou? And he said unto him, I am a Levite of Bethlehemjudah, and I go to sojourn where I may find a place.
verses.pt: o qual lhe perguntou: Donde vens? E ele lhe respondeu: Sou levita de Belém de Judá, e vou peregrinar onde achar conveniente.
verses.en_web: Micah said to him, “Where did you come from?” He said to him, “I am a Levite of Bethlehem Judah, and I am looking for a place to live.”
verses.en_bbe: And Micah said to him, Where do you come from? And he said to him, I am a Levite from Beth-lehem-judah, and I am looking for a living-place.

verses.en: And Micah said unto him, Dwell with me, and be unto me a father and a priest, and I will give thee ten shekels of silver by the year, and a suit of apparel, and thy victuals. So the Levite went in.
verses.pt: Então lhe disse Mica: Fica comigo, e sê-me por pai e sacerdote; e cada ano te darei dez moedas de prata, o vestuário e o sustento. E o levita entrou.
verses.en_web: Micah said to him, “Dwell with me, and be to me a father and a priest, and I will give you ten pieces of silver per year, a suit of clothing, and your food.” So the Levite went in.
verses.en_bbe: Then Micah said to him, Make your living-place with me, and be a father and a priest to me, and I will give you ten shekels of silver a year and your clothing and food.

verses.en: And the Levite was content to dwell with the man; and the young man was unto him as one of his sons.
verses.pt: Consentiu, pois, o levita em ficar com aquele homem, e lhe foi como um de seus filhos.
verses.en_web: The Levite was content to dwell with the man; and the young man was to him as one of his sons.
verses.en_bbe: And the Levite said he would make his living-place with the man, and he became to him as one of his sons.

verses.en: And Micah consecrated the Levite; and the young man became his priest, and was in the house of Micah.
verses.pt: E Mica consagrou o levita, e o mancebo lhe serviu de sacerdote, e ficou em sua casa.
verses.en_web: Micah consecrated the Levite, and the young man became his priest, and was in the house of Micah.
verses.en_bbe: And Micah gave the position to the Levite, and the young man became his priest, and was in the house of Micah.

verses.en: Then said Micah, Now know I that the LORD will do me good, seeing I have a Levite to my priest.
verses.pt: Então disse Mica: Agora sei que o Senhor me fará bem, porquanto tenho um levita por sacerdote.
verses.en_web: Then Micah said, “Now know I that Yahweh will do good to me, since I have a Levite as my priest.”
verses.en_bbe: Then Micah said, Now I am certain that the Lord will do me good, seeing that the Levite has become my priest.
